claims.claim_text_verbatim: We introduce a self-improvement loop for reasoning models based on the following observation: Even when the difficulty of a problem exceeds the model’s current solving abilities, an additionally supplied solution might enable the model to extract useful solution ideas in hindsight.
claims.claim_summary: Self-improvement loop uses supplied solutions to extract hindsight solution ideas.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We operationalize this by jointly training the same model to exhibit the following three capabilities: predicting solution ideas from problems alone, reverse-engineering ideas from problems and known solutions, and solving problems using provided ideas.
claims.claim_summary: Model is jointly trained for foresight, hindsight, and problem solving using ideas.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The loop alternates between reverse engineering such ideas from problems with supplied solutions and using these ideas as additional supervision for joint training of all three capabilities.
claims.claim_summary: Training alternates between reverse-engineering ideas and joint training on all capabilities.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We give a formal specification of our method and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation remains future work.
claims.claim_summary: Formal method specification and Lean instantiation provided, without empirical evaluation yet.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Such a reconstructed idea can then provide additional supervision for learning to develop a solution idea from the problem alone, before attempting to solve it.
claims.claim_summary: Reconstructed ideas provide additional supervision for predicting ideas from problems alone.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The centerpiece of our method is an alternating training loop.
claims.claim_summary: An alternating training loop forms the centerpiece of the proposed method.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Thus, the capability responsible for producing additional supervision is itself an explicit training target.
claims.claim_summary: The hindsight capability providing supervision is itself an explicit training target.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We express solution ideas at several levels of detail, forming a hierarchy from overarching strategies to detailed plans.
claims.claim_summary: Solution ideas are represented as multi-level hierarchies from strategies to plans.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The ideas reverse-engineered by the hindsight component are intended to provide guidance that could plausibly be followed from the problem alone, rather than merely describe the supplied solution or reflect hindsight bias.
claims.claim_summary: Reverse-engineered ideas aim to provide forward-usable guidance without hindsight bias.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We provide an optional refinement of our method which accomplishes this in the case of verifiable problem domains, i.e., when proposed solution candidates can be procedurally verified: For each problem and reference solution, we generate several candidate hierarchies in hindsight.
claims.claim_summary: Optional refinement for verifiable domains generates candidate hindsight hierarchies for selection.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We retain the highest-scoring hierarchy and an associated valid solution for training, provided the score meets an acceptance threshold.
claims.claim_summary: The highest-scoring hierarchy meeting a threshold is retained for model training.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We provide a formal specification of our method for a general problem setting, together with the optional refinement for verifiable problem domains.
claims.claim_summary: Paper provides formal specification for general and verifiable problem settings.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We also give a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover [2], where natural language proof ideas guide tactic generation during proof search.
claims.claim_summary: Concrete Lean instantiation guides tactic generation using natural language proof ideas.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Our Lean instantiation builds on language-model-guided proof search, conditioning tactic generation on learned hierarchies of proof ideas.
claims.claim_summary: Lean instantiation conditions tactic generation on learned hierarchies of proof ideas.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Our hierarchies are intended to describe solution ideas at different levels of granularity, providing guidance for subsequent solving.
claims.claim_summary: Hierarchies describe solution ideas at varied granularities to guide solving.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In the case of verifiable problem domains, our method uses separate solving attempts to assess reverse-engineered hierarchies and selects training triples based on that assessment.
claims.claim_summary: Verifiable domain method assesses reverse-engineered hierarchies using separate solving attempts.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Our method makes retrospective generation of hierarchies (i.e., rationales at several levels of detail) an explicitly trained task.
claims.claim_summary: Retrospective generation of multi-level hierarchies is an explicitly trained task.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Each retained training triple supervises all three tasks.
claims.claim_summary: Retained training triples provide joint supervision across all three tasks.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The training loop alternates between generating training triples by reverse engineering hierarchies and jointly training on the above three tasks.
claims.claim_summary: Training alternates between retrospective hierarchy generation and joint component training.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This differs from the forward generation of thoughts and tactics in Lean-STaR’s expert iterations, and from DeepInsight’s retrospective rationale generation using a teacher model: our loop repeatedly performs retrospective hierarchy generation with the same backbone that learns to predict and use the resulting hierarchies.
claims.claim_summary: Method differs by iteratively updating retrospective generation using the same shared backbone.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Finally, in verifiable problem domains, we additionally assess the reverse-engineered hierarchies through separate solving attempts, in which the model receives the problem and hierarchy while the reference solution is withheld.
claims.claim_summary: Reverse-engineered hierarchies are assessed by solving attempts with reference solutions withheld.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In practice, a hierarchy z ∈ Z for a problem x ∈ X is intended to represent a semantically meaningful idea, plan, or approach for constructing a solution y ∈ Y for x at different levels of granularity: From a detailed solution sketch z0 to a coarse description of the overarching idea zn.
claims.claim_summary: Hierarchies represent semantically meaningful solution ideas across fine and coarse granularity levels.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Our central hypothesis is that reverse engineering the idea underlying a known solution is, in general, easier than discovering it from the problem alone.
claims.claim_summary: Core hypothesis: reverse engineering solution ideas is easier than discovering them directly.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: We operationalize this hypothesis through a training loop that alternates between reverse engineering ideas from known solutions (hindsight) and training the model using these ideas.
claims.claim_summary: Hypothesis operationalized by alternating between reverse-engineering hindsight ideas and model training.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In our implementation, we seek to mitigate this risk through corresponding instructions in the language model’s prompt templates.
claims.claim_summary: Prompt instructions are used to mitigate hindsight bias in reverse-engineered ideas.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This introduces an additional training signal in the spirit of expert iteration.
claims.claim_summary: Scoring and filtering candidate hierarchies introduces an expert-iteration training signal.
